copy.headline: Take the same questions to every consultation
copy.copy: The toolkit includes a printable consultation worksheet and a spreadsheet that turns each lawyer's answers into a comparable estimated total.

copy.headline: Comparing contingency agreements? Do the math first
copy.copy: The toolkit shows each lawyer's fee and what you would receive under their agreement (percentage, step-ups and whether costs come off before or after the fee), plus a 23-point agreement checklist.

copy.headline: Organize what your family will need to find
copy.copy: Whatever documents you choose, the binder records where they are, who to call and which accounts exist, without passwords or full account numbers. It is not a will.

copy.headline: After the will: tell your family where everything is
copy.copy: The binder records where your will and other documents are kept, key contacts and accounts, without passwords or full account numbers. It does not replace a will.

copy.headline: Help your agent find what they need
copy.copy: The binder lists where documents are, which accounts exist and who to call, so the person you name can act quickly. It is not a power of attorney.
